diagnostic_limits: Rule coverage and known recovery value only; no full manual review and no guarantee that arbitrary unknown secrets are absent
next_action: Operator runs the staged private screening launcher and shares only status and counts; independently validate its public report before continuing
privacy: Existing recovery input solely in guest memory/subprocess stdin; all scanner input/output guest memory only; only fixed report fields/counts/hashes public; no raw log excerpts published

scanner.config: Default rules plus low-entropy installer password assignment rule; no repository configuration/allowlist; inline suppressions ignored
scanner.guest_network: unshare --net required; guest execution still NOT_RUN

scope: Short private whole-log diagnostic; original manual-review attestation and mandatory gates preserved

validation.coverage: Clean and empty inputs, simple assignments and inline ignore refusal, both ends and middle of large input, sealed executable/config, malformed/unredacted/missing controls, positions-only output, binary/encoding refusal, network isolation arguments, private TTY guard, every file, changed-log refusal, G03/manual-review non-promotion and matching rerun
initial_failures_preserved_in_tool_trans: Public TOML quoting fixed before staging
Synthetic report fixture parent mode corrected before retained passing run
